rights: You have the right to a written employment contract or offer letter clearly stating your terms of employment.
Wages must be paid on time — within 7 days of the wage period for smaller establishments, 10 days for larger ones (Payment of Wages Act, 1936).
Post-employment non-compete clauses are generally unenforceable in India under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872.
You are entitled to the notice period specified in your contract, or payment in lieu of notice, for termination by either party.
For workers employed continuously for one year or more, retrenchment requires one month's notice and compensation of 15 days' average pay per completed year of service.
Unauthorized deductions from wages are prohibited. Only legally permitted deductions (PF, tax, etc.) may be made.
Gig workers and platform workers may be entitled to social security benefits under the Code on Social Security, 2020 (implementation varies by state).
You have the right to a safe working environment under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020.
Termination must follow due process — arbitrary dismissal without following the procedure in the contract or applicable law may be challenged.
